closeout_failures.failed_witness: The first closeout inventory ripgrep command embedded a broken PowerShell quote and was rejected before reading files or changing Git state.
closeout_failures.recovery: Repeated only the read-only inventory with one literal single-quoted pattern and obtained an attributable stale-domain list.
closeout_failures.recurrence_guard: Keep complex ripgrep alternations in a literal PowerShell string and avoid nested quote fragments.

operational_failed_witnesses.failed_witness: The first broad read of the prior x2 template exceeded the model-visible output bound before every section was attributable.
operational_failed_witnesses.recovery: Read the exact template function outline and deterministic source windows, then materialized only the bounded Orin-owned derivative through patches.
operational_failed_witnesses.recurrence_guard: Inventory large templates first and use bounded line windows rather than one unbounded content projection.

operational_failed_witnesses.failed_witness: The first stale-label review passed Windows wildcard paths literally and used an overbroad ENC substring, so ripgrep returned path errors and one false match.
operational_failed_witnesses.recovery: Materialized the exact untracked file array and repeated a word-aware bounded scan, which found no stale prior-phase or marine-chart domain label.
operational_failed_witnesses.recurrence_guard: Expand Windows path sets before ripgrep and use semantic word boundaries for short abbreviations such as ENC.

operational_failed_witnesses.failed_witness: The first untracked-path parity projection used porcelain status, which collapsed two untracked directories and therefore reported 20 paths instead of 54.
operational_failed_witnesses.recovery: Used git ls-files --others --exclude-standard and proved exact 54-of-54 path parity with no missing or unexpected owner path.
operational_failed_witnesses.recurrence_guard: Use git ls-files --others for file-level untracked allowlist parity rather than directory-collapsing porcelain output.
